name: fourth-wall-gaming

plugins.name: mythras-gm
plugins.description: Run persistent tabletop RPG campaigns as Gamesmaster using Mythras Imperative rules, with all game state in TypeDB. Includes dice engine, combat resolution, character generation, campaign publishing, and worldbuilding persistence.

plugins.name: purewater
plugins.description: And Then the Dragons Came: Purewater. A canal city, a Baron with a concealed champion, three days to the Tourney. Needs the mythras-gm engine: Claude Code installs it as a dependency, Codex does not -- install mythras-gm alongside it there.

plugins.name: veilwrack
plugins.description: The Veilwrack: The Stilling. An original sky-realm campaign. Winged Alar on the floating bone-spires of dead sky-leviathans, and the wind itself is dying. Needs the mythras-gm engine: Claude Code installs it as a dependency, Codex does not -- install mythras-gm alongside it there.

plugins.name: first-through
plugins.description: First Through. A first roleplaying game for 10-15 year olds, set in the real stellar neighbourhood: seedships carried anchor pairs out at a twentieth of lightspeed, and where one arrived a door opened. You are fifteen, the newest the Threshold has taken in years, and the old doors are failing faster than age explains. Danger is real and always named before it is taken. Needs the mythras-gm engine: Claude Code installs it as a dependency, Codex does not -- install mythras-gm alongside it there.
